tasks.label: Abrir CESMAC no Chrome
tasks.command: $url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'; $port = 8000; $python = (Get-Command py.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; $pythonPrefix = @('-3'); if (-not $python) { $python = (Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; $pythonPrefix = @() } $ready = $false; foreach ($candidate in 8000,8001) { $candidateUrl = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + $candidate; $healthy = $false; try { $health = Invoke-RestMethod ($candidateUrl + '/api/v1/health') -TimeoutSec 2; $contract = Invoke-WebRequest ($candidateUrl + '/openapi.yaml') -TimeoutSec 2 -UseBasicParsing; $healthy = ($health.status -eq 'ok' -and $contract.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $contract.Content -match 'openapi: 3.0.3') } catch {}; if ($healthy) { $port = $candidate; $url = $candidateUrl; $ready = $true; break }; $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $candidate -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $listener) { $port = $candidate; $url = $candidateUrl; break } }; if (-not $python) { throw 'Python não encontrado. Instale o Python e reabra o VS Code.' }; if (-not $ready) { $stdout = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cesmac-achados-server.log'; $stderr = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cesmac-achados-server-error.log'; Start-Process -FilePath $python -ArgumentList ($pythonPrefix + @('app/server.py','--port',[string]$port)) -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}' -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $stdout -RedirectStandardError $stderr; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 20; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; try { $health = Invoke-RestMethod ($url + '/api/v1/health') -TimeoutSec 2; $contract = Invoke-WebRequest ($url + '/openapi.yaml') -TimeoutSec 2 -UseBasicParsing; if ($health.status -eq 'ok' -and $contract.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $contract.Content -match 'openapi: 3.0.3') { $ready = $true; break } } catch {} }; if (-not $ready) { $details = if (Test-Path $stderr) { Get-Content $stderr -Raw } else { 'Sem detalhes no log.' }; throw ('O servidor não iniciou corretamente na porta ' + $port + '. Log: ' + $details) } }; $chromePaths = @((Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'), (Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'), (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe')); $chrome = $chromePaths | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $chrome) { throw 'Não encontrei o Google Chrome instalado.' }; Start-Process -FilePath $chrome -ArgumentList $url; Write-Host ('CESMAC aberto no Chrome em ' + $url + '. Servidor ativo em segundo plano.')
